data.name: Workflow4
data.value: Capture a field near the celestial pole

data.name: Workflow5
data.value: Rotate only the RA axis by 60–90°

data.name: Workflow6
data.value: Adjust the bolts until the markers overlap

data.name: Workflow8
data.value: Point near the celestial pole and capture the first reference. Plate solving uses the surrounding star pattern, rather than Polaris alone.

data.name: Workflow9
data.value: Keep altitude, azimuth and DEC fixed. Rotate RA only, let the mount settle, then capture the second reference.

data.name: Workflow10
data.value: Keep RA and the camera fixed. Adjust only the altitude and azimuth bolts in small steps, checking the next measurement.

data.name: MeasurementComplete
data.value: {0:HH:mm:ss} measured - adjust in small steps and check the next result.

data.name: Live0
data.value: Check the camera connection, observing site and plate solver settings.

data.name: Live1
data.value: References cleared. Capture the first reference again.

data.name: Live3
data.value: Capturing and solving the reference field -

data.name: Live4
data.value: Calibration complete. Start live adjustment, then adjust the altitude and azimuth bolts.

data.name: Live5
data.value: First reference solved. Rotate RA only, then capture the second reference.

data.name: Live6
data.value: Capturing and solving the next frame -

data.name: Live7
data.value: Measurement stopped. Resume or reset the references.

data.name: Live8
data.value: Measurement failed. Check the error and try again.

data.name: Field3
data.value: Reference image - start measurement to update guidance

data.name: View0
data.value: Resize the image and control panels

data.name: View4
data.value: Illustration only. Actual rotation is measured after capture.

data.name: View11
data.value: Directions describe telescope movement while facing the celestial pole, rather than which way to turn a bolt.

data.name: FocusTip
data.value: Zoom to the alignment markers. Turn off to fit the full image.

data.name: Details
data.value: Celestial Pole: target direction. RA Axis: measured rotation axis. Dashed rings show angular distance from the pole. Hardware accuracy has not yet been verified; atmospheric refraction is not applied.

data.name: StreamingMode
data.value: Native video - latest frame + plate solve

data.name: StreamingHint
data.value: Adjustment only; references use still captures. Every displayed measurement is plate solved.

data.name: StreamingUnsupported
data.value: Requires a connected native ZWO ASI or ToupTek camera. Other drivers use single frames.

data.name: StreamingStarting
data.value: Starting native video and plate solving...

data.name: StreamingEnded
data.value: Camera stream ended. Restart or select single frames.

data.name: FieldRecordHint
data.value: Records start with the first reference. Reset before changing this option. Images are saved for references and Mark only.

data.name: FieldNotesHint
data.value: Add a note before Mark or Stability, e.g. mount untouched, bolt adjustment, or independent comparison.

data.name: FieldMarkHint
data.value: Save the latest measured frame, RAW FITS when available, processed preview and note. Does not take a new exposure.

data.name: FieldRecordingReady
data.value: Field log starts with the first reference.

data.name: FieldScatter
data.value: Repeatability ({0} frames): Alt sigma {1:0.0} arcsec / Az sigma {2:0.0} arcsec. Not absolute accuracy.

data.name: FieldStabilityHint
data.value: Stability collects 20 new frames. Keep bolts, RA, DEC and camera fixed.
